edge_rule: FEEDFORWARD edges carry a receipt to a later beam inside one pulse and form a DAG. FEEDBACK edges carry a result into the NEXT pulse, so the graph unrolled by pulse stays acyclic.
progress_rule: Beam progress = items in DONE, CONTROL, SUPERSEDED or INVALIDATED divided by items in the beam. A beam with no items reports its gate fraction instead. Forecasts never count.

beams.title: Gate integrity
beams.entry: A CI gate claims a pass.
beams.exit: Every unittest gate executes >0 tests; zero-test guard runs on every workflow or test change; distinct-source repeat observed.

beams.title: Merge admission
beams.entry: A PR is ready to merge.
beams.exit: first-pass-closure is a required status; red provably blocks merge (#336).
beams.trigger: pull_request_target -> first-pass-closure-gate.yml; ruleset is an owner/admin action

beams.title: DMAIC iteration (ABACUS)
beams.entry: Iteration N+1 consumes a CONTROL receipt from N.
beams.exit: Each depth D1..D3 reaches exact-head CONTROL and recensus; contract records job ids.
beams.trigger: ABACUS push / schedule (00:20, 06:13, 12:11 UTC) -> DMAIC V3 Test Suite; consumed by a hub PR that edits GM_DMAIC_EVOLUTION_T7_T14_T21_v1.json

beams.title: Top7 recensus pulses
beams.exit: Two fresh pulses with exact heads for 7/7 repos; proof-debt trend and repeat metric bound.
beams.trigger: Hub PR that appends to TOP7_CENSUS_PULSES_v1.json; child proofs via push, schedule or workflow_dispatch

beams.title: Top7 -> Top14 promotion gate
beams.exit: gm_dmaic_evolution_metrics.py reports top14_promotion_ready=true and a human GO is recorded.
beams.trigger: push to master on the contract -> gm-dmaic-evolution.yml

beams.title: QPS federation edge
beams.exit: Edge bound to run id, head SHA, job id and >0 steps.
beams.trigger: cryoplant push (read-only bind); new dispatch blocked by cryoplant#923

beams.title: Dispatch and return bus
beams.entry: Owner grants a cross-repo token or App.
beams.exit: One bounded satellite task dispatched and returned with exact digests.
beams.trigger: Not wired: needs repository_dispatch or App-token workflow_dispatch

beams.title: Atlas and observability
beams.exit: Atlas built from repo files in CI; predicates, evidence age, series and queue visible; browser QA in CI.
beams.trigger: pull_request / push on mission-control/federation-atlas/** and cited sources -> code-purple-method-atlas.yml

beams.title: Telemetry, PCA, BT and forecasts
beams.exit: Six #520 KPIs bound; forecasts issued before outcomes and scored (MAE, Brier).
beams.trigger: workflow_run / bounded dispatch collector (#520), not yet built

beams.title: LM-10 MIP roundtrip (gg_MATH)
beams.exit: Pulse 1 provider, pulse 2 Mission Control, pulse 3 ABACUS consumer all bound (#129).
beams.trigger: gg_MATH LM-10 Signal Stack run -> hub PR -> ABACUS #1164
